card.name: The word ionic, plus scattered openers
card.fires_on: Mainly the word 'ionic' before nouns like osmotic, form or biosensors. It also fires weakly on sentence openers such as 'On', 'Many', 'between' and on an opening parenthesis.

modes.label: Scattered openers
modes.description: A sentence-starting word or opening bracket in general web prose.
